//: Emits dist/. Relative imports in src/ carry explicit .js extensions so the
output is valid Node ESM without a resolver step — the runtime plugin in
particular is loaded by Vite from inside node_modules, where nothing will
rewrite an extensionless specifier for us.
skipLibCheck is true HERE, for building this package. It says nothing about
the apps: their tsconfig keeps skipLibCheck false, and dist/meta/*.d.ts is
checked under that setting, which is why the ./meta entry imports nothing.
